main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads rectangle height and width from standard input, tries all horizontal and vertical first cuts followed by a second straight cut, and prints the minimum difference between the largest and smallest piece areas." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize ans to 10000000000000 as the initial minimum area difference. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Read two integers from standard input into h and w using scanf with format %d %d. RESULT h,w]
            [COMMAND Enter the first outer loop over horizontal split positions: set int i = 1; continue while i < h; increment i by 1 after each iteration. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, compute square[0] = (long long)i * w, square[1] = (long long)(h - i) * (w / 2), and square[2] = (long long)(h - i) * (w - w / 2). RESULT square]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, reset min to 10000000000000 and max to 0. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, for each j from 0 to 2 inclusive, update min to square[j] if min > square[j], and update max to square[j] if max < square[j]. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, if ans > llabs(max - min), set ans to llabs(max - min). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, recompute square[1] = ((long long)(h - i) / 2) * w and square[2] = ((long long)(h - i) - (long long)(h - i) / 2) * w. RESULT square]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, reset min to 10000000000000 and max to 0. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, for each j from 0 to 2 inclusive, update min to square[j] if min > square[j], and update max to square[j] if max < square[j]. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the first outer loop, if ans > llabs(max - min), set ans to llabs(max - min). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Enter the second outer loop over vertical split positions: set int i = 0; continue while i < w; increment i by 1 after each iteration. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, compute square[0] = (long long)i * h, square[1] = (long long)(w - i) * (h / 2), and square[2] = (long long)(w - i) * (h - h / 2). RESULT square]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, reset min to 10000000000000 and max to 0. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, for each j from 0 to 2 inclusive, update min to square[j] if min > square[j], and update max to square[j] if max < square[j]. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, if ans > llabs(max - min), set ans to llabs(max - min). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, recompute square[1] = ((long long)(w - i) / 2) * h and square[2] = ((long long)(w - i) - (long long)(w - i) / 2) * h. RESULT square]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, reset min to 10000000000000 and max to 0. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, for each j from 0 to 2 inclusive, update min to square[j] if min > square[j], and update max to square[j] if max < square[j]. RESULT min,max]
            [COMMAND Within the second outer loop, if ans > llabs(max - min), set ans to llabs(max - min). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Print ans to standard output as a long long value followed by a newline. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main. RESULT return_code]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
